purpose: Single machine-readable authority retaining domain/task proof obligations while grouping review/revert boundaries. It records intent and evidence state; it never promotes branch evidence or creates an admission.

branch_provenance.rule: G0 starts at series_origin_ref; every later promoted group/campaign records the then-current upstream base and must use a pinned 40-hex commit.

pr_527.note: Retain PR #527 as historical provenance; do not treat its checklist or cumulative diff as an upstream implementation boundary.

status_definitions.complete: The obligation is current and closed; this is not a GitHub merge claim.
status_definitions.in_review: The authority group is complete and reviewable; no merge or downstream completion is claimed.
status_definitions.ready: Its consumed seam/development prerequisites are available for review; no acceptance is implied.
status_definitions.blocked: A dependency, seam, design, or qualifying evidence prerequisite is unavailable.
status_definitions.implemented: The grouped files are prepared in this commit, but no evidence receipt or merge claim is promoted.

policy.branch_evidence_rule: Branch reports and measurements remain historical provenance. A rerun_required row needs a durable current-tree report before completion; hardware_blocked rows require the distinct physical topology named by their contract. Repository report paths must exist and be approved report-like artifacts under docs/, tests/, or benchmarks/ (not Cargo.toml, crates/, or other source/config); GitHub commit/blob URLs must contain an immutable 40-hex commit and valid structure; bogus hashes and local-only .agent-progress paths are rejected.
policy.one_row_rule: Enforceable as one-row-per-obligation: each obligation's advancement.completion_rows may contain at most one ID; a PR may advance at most one obligation without a reliable base-diff of the implementation commit. Absent such a base-diff mechanism, group, campaign, and final-closure completion are gated by child obligation status and seam availability, not by PR diff. Dependency or evidence metadata may be synchronized without advancing another row.
policy.grouping_rule: Each domain obligation ID appears exactly once across grouped change sets, evidence campaigns, and final closure. legacy_pr_ids are provenance only.
policy.completion_promotion_rule: Only current durable evidence with nonempty non-host-local references can promote a group, campaign, or final closure. Durable references must exist on disk or be immutable GitHub commit/blob URLs with 40-hex objects; nonexistent paths, Cargo.toml-as-report, malformed hash URLs, and host-local/.agent-progress references never promote. Historical, semantics-only, emulated, failed, hardware_blocked, and host-local evidence never promotes.
policy.parallel_lane_rule: Canonical landing chain is G1(hipfire-pr-673) -> G3(hipfire-pr-675) -> G5(hipfire-pr-677); G2(hipfire-pr-674) is a sibling after G1 and a semantic prerequisite before complete production multi-device enablement, not a prerequisite for G3. G3 and G4 may develop in parallel after authority; the interface-safe part of G5 may develop after authority (after G1 topology) while merge waits on its manifest seam S-MANIFEST. G6-G11 fan out after their consumed G5 seams. G13-G15 are implementation-only; physical campaigns follow them.
